shortDescription: Generic installer for various packaging formats.

options.name: action
options.description: Controls what is performed. C(install) performs an install of the specified software. C(uninstall) performs an uninstall of the specified software. C(list) lists the contents of the media.

options.name: agree_licenses
options.description: Agrees to required software license agreements for software to be installed.

options.name: device
options.description: Specifies the device or directory that contains the images to install. The geninstall command searches for the images in the following paths /mount_point/installp/ppc (installp package), /mount_point/RPMS/ppc (RPM package), /mount_point/emgr/ppc (Interim fix packages for AIX), /mount_point/ISMP/ppc (ISMP packages for AIX). options.name: force
options.description: Force the operation allowing to reinstall a package that is already installed, or to install a package that is older than the currently installed version.

options.name: install_list
options.description: List of products to install C(all) installs all products C(update_all) updates all products

options.name: installp_flags
options.description: Specifies the installp flags to use when calling the installp command.
